description:
“Do I seem like the type to live off women?”

It was just one night,

yet Yeon Dahae turned my life upside down.

Running into her again was pure chance.

“I’m sorry for leaving without paying you.”

“Yeon Dahae, manager of the upcoming ‘Only You: Coffee & Flower,’ opening next week.”

I couldn’t let this slip by.

“I’m not after money—I’d rather settle it differently. What do you say?”

I had to figure out why that morning, when she left without a word, I felt so hollow and restless.

“How about this: we meet whenever we want, without strings or complications?”

She said that even Donghwa, the only man in her life, was gone.

All I needed to do was enjoy it—nothing more.

“Fine, but no meddling in each other’s personal lives or work.”

I was certain I wouldn’t get too attached…

So why do I keep wanting to stay near her?

Why won’t this odd feeling fade?
